title: Bishoujo Senshi Sailor Moon S: Jougai Rantou!? Shuyaku Soudatsusen - Crystal Tokyo (Night)
description:
A nice background with stars and a moon. Useful for any calm nighttime setting. This background may look best with a pared-down status bar, and perhaps a patch to slow horizontal background movement.

Uses palette 3, BG1 and a small part of BG2.

Please give credit if used.
